_comment: Copy to brief/household.json (git-ignored) and fill in real names. GRADES ARE ANCHORS, not literals: store the grade together with the school year it was true in, and it is computed forward from there -- so it rolls over every August by itself instead of going quietly stale. 0 is kindergarten, 1 is first grade, and NEGATIVE numbers are the years before kindergarten. `grade_labels` is keyed BY GRADE NUMBER, not by child, so a school's own name for a year (e.g. a transitional year below kindergarten) follows the grade and a child simply moves out of it.
